title: Tokenized margin & runway notes
content:
Top-level goal: quick, small doc for my own back-of-envelope thinking about using tokenized credits + small retainer to smooth unit economics and encourage warm-cache behaviour. Not a product doc; brain dump.

Key intuition: warm KV cache and small reserved capacity are very valuable on high-concurrency chat paths. We can capture that value via session-style credits + tiny retainer that increases probability of warm cache reuse (and reduces p99 cost).

Assumptions (rough)
- GPU cost per active token (amortized, all overheads): $0.0000035 per token (weighted mix of 80% Ampere, 20% H100, weighted utilization).
- Serving infra markup + ops + SLO buffer: x1.6 -> effective cost per token = $0.0000056.
- Margin target (hosted) on PAYG: 40% (today we target 30-50 depending on tier).
- Target retail price per token (PAYG baseline): $0.0000093 (=> margin ~40%).

Sessionized offering idea (light retainer + credits)
- Starter retainer: $5/mo -> includes 5,000 session-credits. Extra credits at $0.0012/credit. Each session-credit = 1 active session with warm cache for up to 2k tokens.
- Effective tokens per credit assumption: 800 tokens / session-credit (avg short session).
- Implied price per token inside retainer: $5 / (5,000 * 800) = $5 / 4,000,000 = $0.00000125 per token (insane), but this is amortized across many cheap sessions where we heavily rely on cached prefixes. Real uplift: users won’t use all credits; behavioral rebate.

Quick sanity math for a small app (100k monthly tokens)
- PAYG at $0.0000093 => revenue = $0.93
- Cost = 100k * $0.0000056 = $0.56 -> gross margin = $0.37
- If 30% of tokens are warm-cached due to session retainer, cost falls by ~30% on those tokens (cache hit reduces compute) -> cost delta 
  - new cost approx = (0.7*100k + 0.3*100k*0.6) * 0.0000056 ~ (70k + 18k)*0.0000056 = 88k * 0.0000056 = $0.49 -> margin expands.

Channeling activation mechanics
- Small retainer subsidizes warm cache allocation (we pin a small working set per customer).
- Behavioral: credit expiry + gentle auto-replenish nudges usage.
- Onboarding: give 1 month free retainer to new sign-ups to prove latency benefit.

Micro-pricing levers to tune
- Credit sizing (tokens per credit) - coarse control for UX vs cost predictability.
- Warm-window length (seconds) - operational knob that trades memory for hit-rate.
- Overdraft protection and fallback pricing (PAYG at per-token vs consume credits first).

Three simple pricing experiments to run (A/B friendly)
1) Free retainer pilot: give 7-day $3 retainer credit on signup + show p95 latency improvement. Metric: retention + monthly tokens.
2) Tiny monthly retainer vs pure PAYG: $3/mo w/ 2,000 credits vs $0 PAYG. Metric: conversion to paying, churn after 60d.
3) Session-bundles: sell 5-session bundle ($1.75) vs per-session PAYG. Metric: bundle take rate and effective cost per session.

Unit-econ quick checks (for a cohort of 10k small apps)
- If 10k customers take $3 retainer -> ARR = $360k.
- Allocated infra overhead for pinned working sets for these customers: estimate extra RAM/GPU scheduling cost = $40k/yr.
- Remaining gross margin can support marketing and S&M. Back-of-envelope shows viability if activation -> retention similar to other micro-commitments.

Operational notes / constraints
- We need a cheap way to tag requests as "pinned-session" to route to pinned pools. That requires small control-plane additions (route key + TTL). TODO: file infra ticket.
- Billing: sessions credits must be visible in Console and via API. Product + DX work.
- Risk: heavy tail customers gaming cheap credits for long-running contexts; introduce per-session max token cap and escalate to paid tier.

Open questions (notes to self)
- How to price for embeddings-heavy but low-latency workloads (different cost profile).
- Can we combine with Dedicated offers (dedicated pool discounts + session retainer as SLA enhancer)?
- Hard stop: what is minimum retainer to make warm pins cost-effective on average? Need sampling run from logs to estimate hit-rate vs pinned memory.

Data I should pull next (quick):
- Per-tenant session token distribution (90/50/10 quantiles) last 30 days -> bucketize.
- Per-request latency delta when served from cached prefix vs cold start.
- Cost per pinned GB and likely memory footprint per customer prefix.

Immediate TODOs
- Add infra ticket: PIN-201 (control plane route tag + TTL). (create after this doc)
- Slack note to #pricing-experiments with short poll on $3 vs $5 retainer cues.
- Quick log pull: sample 10k sessions to estimate tokens-per-session median and tail (ask data infra).

Rough UX copy snippets (for product mock)
- "Keep your assistant warm: $3/mo includes 2,000 session-credits to reduce response latency and lower per-interaction cost."
- Tooltip: "Session-credit = 1 short conversation where your recent messages are kept hot for faster responses."

Random heuristics (brain dump)
- Price per credit should feel like "frictionless" (round numbers: $0.0012/credit -> $1 for ~800 credits).
- Bundle vs subscription: bundles are easier to A/B test; small subs support retention.
- Consider free tier retention hack: one free warm-session per day for X days.

Notes end.

Unfinished -- leave messy math here so I can iterate.
